cmd_toggle_site.message: Pause or resume blocking on this site

ext_desc.message: Blocks ads, trackers and pop-ups. Great on Chinese sites, with custom rules, right-click hiding and statistics.

menu_toggle_site.message: Pause / resume blocking on this site

opt_added_block.message: Added to the block list. Save to apply.

opt_advanced_info.message: $1 site script rules · $2 advanced element rules. Supports part of the upstream syntax; not every site or video ad is guaranteed.

opt_allow_desc.message: Wins over block rules; network requests only. Up to 500.

opt_autoupdate_desc.message: Checked once a day while the browser runs. Requires saving.

opt_backup_bad_compat.message: The backup has invalid compatibility sites

opt_backup_bad_rules.message: The backup has duplicate, invalid or too many rules

opt_backup_desc.message: The JSON backup includes your site lists and rules. Importing replaces current settings but not the list version.

opt_backup_too_big.message: The backup file is too large

opt_badge_desc.message: A small number on the icon. The panel always shows it.

opt_badge_title.message: Show the blocked count on the toolbar icon

opt_chart_aria.message: Blocked per day over the last 14 days

opt_compat_desc.message: Turns off element hiding and site fixes and lets the site load its own requests; third-party ad filtering stays on. Up to 200.

opt_diag_desc.message: Records the last 200 rule matches to help find false positives. Kept for this browser session only, with query strings removed.

opt_direct_desc.message: Rejects them instead of serving an empty local stand-in. May trigger anti-adblock notices.

opt_elements_desc.message: Right-click a page and choose “Hide this element…”, or pick from the toolbar panel. Rules apply to that site and its subdomains, up to 300.

opt_enabled_desc.message: When off, all network filtering, element hiding and pop-up blocking pause.

opt_enhanced_info.message: $1 ad and tracking domains · version $2 · $3. Filters third-party requests only and may affect site widgets; turn it off or allow domains if needed.

opt_exceptions_desc.message: One domain per line, including subdomains. Reload pages after saving.

opt_exported.message: Settings exported to your Downloads folder.

opt_filters_desc.message: Filtering by URL path, resource type and site. Lists update with each release.

opt_filters_placeholder.message:
! Comments start with an exclamation mark
||ads.example.com^
||example.com/banner/*$image,third-party
@@||cdn.example.com^$script
example.com##.sponsored
##.ad-slot-top

opt_filters_too_long.message: My filter rules are too long (200,000 characters max)

opt_footer.message: Settings stay on this device. Updating lists connects to GitHub, which sees ordinary connection details; no browsing history, allowlists or settings are sent.

opt_hideads_desc.message: Hides ad slots and empty frames from the lists; your own element rules are kept separately.

opt_intro.message: Browse quietly and keep only what you came for. Manage blocking, site exceptions and your own rules here; everything stays on this device.

opt_last_error.message: Last update failed; the working list is kept: $1

opt_list_annoy.message: Cookie banners and newsletter pop-overs; more likely to over-hide

opt_list_chinese.message: Sites in Taiwan, Hong Kong and China (includes EasyList China)

opt_list_fixes.message: Site fixes, anti-adblock handling and false-positive exceptions

opt_list_reset.message: Built-in list restored. Your settings are unchanged.

opt_logging_desc.message: Requires saving; works only when the extension is loaded unpacked (developer mode).

opt_logs_off.message: Recording is off. Turn it on, save, then reload the site to check.

opt_mode_added.message: Site mode added. Save to apply.

opt_mode_strict_long.message: Strict: may affect sign-in and redirects

opt_myfilters_desc.message: Write your own rules in common Adblock Plus / uBlock Origin syntax, or paste a domain list. They take priority over the built-in lists; the allowlist still wins.

opt_popupmode_desc.message: Standard keeps links, sign-in windows and form redirects working while known pop-up ad networks are still blocked. Strict may block sign-in and authorisation, so turn it on only for specific sites. Reload pages after switching.

opt_procedural_desc.message: Finds ad elements by text, parent and style.

opt_protection_desc.message: The master switch and how pop-ups are handled.

opt_ready.message: Settings stay on this device. Press “Save settings” after making changes.

opt_recommended_desc.message: Turns on the main lists, element handling and site fixes. Pop-up mode, outright blocking, third-party restrictions and site exceptions are left as they are.

opt_reset_confirm.message: Clear all statistics? Your settings are not affected.

opt_rule_added.message: Element rule added. Save to apply.

opt_saved.message: Saved. Reload pages for the settings to take full effect.

opt_scriptlets_desc.message: Handles video ads and anti-adblock detection (for example YouTube). Takes effect after reloading.

opt_shadow_desc.message: Also covers Shadow DOM components; paused in compatibility mode.

opt_sitemodes_desc.message: Includes subdomains; the more specific domain wins. Up to 50.

opt_sources_desc.message: Built-in HaGeZi Multi LIGHT covers ad, tracking and malicious domains. Updates download plain domain text only and never run remote code.

opt_stats_since.message: Counting since $1. Numbers stay on this device and are never uploaded.

opt_strict3p_desc.message: Stops 17 mixed-use services from loading on other sites. May affect videos, support chats and cookie consent dialogs.

opt_support_desc.message: Clearview is free, ad-free and collects no browsing data. It is maintained by one person in their spare time. If it makes your web calmer, a donation keeps the list fixes and new features coming.

opt_syntax_1.message: ||ads.example.com^ blocks a domain and its subdomains; you can also write ads.example.com or the hosts format 0.0.0.0 ads.example.com.

opt_syntax_2.message: ||example.com/ads/* and /banner\d+\.gif/ block by URL or regular expression.

opt_syntax_3.message: Lines starting with @@ allow; @@||example.com^$document turns off network filtering on that site.

opt_syntax_5.message: example.com,~shop.example.com##.ad hides elements on given sites; ##.ad applies everywhere. Advanced selectors such as :has-text() work too.

opt_syntax_6.message: Up to 5,000 lines. Script injection (##+js) and element exceptions (#@#) are not supported.

opt_top_sites_empty.message: No data yet. Browse a few sites and come back.

opt_update_done.message: Lists updated. Unsaved form changes are kept.

opt_version_foot.message: Version $1 · Settings stay on this device

opt_whitelist_desc.message: Turns blocking off completely on these sites. Up to 200.

picker_hint.message: Point at the ad and click. Enter to confirm, Esc to cancel.

picker_not_unique.message: This element cannot be identified uniquely; pick a smaller area

picker_selected.message: Selected. Confirm to hide it on this site.

picker_selected_many.message: Selected. $1 matching elements on this page will be hidden together.

picker_too_broad.message: The selector is too long or too broad; pick a smaller element

picker_too_deep.message: Components are nested too deeply; pick an outer container

popup_broken_hint.message: Compatibility mode turns off element hiding and site fixes here and lets this site load its own requests; third-party ad networks stay blocked. Reload the page after switching.

popup_compat_full.message: Compatibility mode holds up to 200 sites. Remove some first.

popup_count_label.message: ads and trackers blocked on this page

popup_milestone.message: Clearview has blocked $1 ads and trackers for you. It is free and never tracks you; if it makes the web calmer, please consider supporting it.

popup_reload_first.message: Reload the page and try again: $1

popup_saved.message: Saved. Reload the page for pop-up and layout settings to take full effect.

popup_sitemodes_full.message: Per-site pop-up settings hold up to 50 domains.

popup_strict3p_hint.message: Stops 17 services from loading on other sites. May affect videos, support chats and consent dialogs.

popup_update_done.message: Lists updated. Your rules and allowlist are kept.

popup_whitelist_full.message: The allowlist holds up to 200 domains. Remove some first.

uf_bad_cosmetic.message: Unsupported element rule syntax (only ## is supported)

uf_generic_too_broad.message: Generic element rule is too broad

uf_no_exceptions.message: Element exceptions are not supported yet; use the allowlist or compatibility mode

uf_selector_invalid.message: Element selector is invalid or too long

uf_url_ascii.message: URL rules must be ASCII (use punycode for non-Latin domains)

wel_heading.message: Welcome — Clearview is already at work

wel_lead.message: Ads, trackers and pop-up ads are blocked automatically, including on Chinese-language sites. No setup needed; just browse.

wel_pin_desc.message: Click the puzzle-piece icon at the top right of your browser, then the pin next to “Clearview”. You will always see how much each page blocked.

wel_pin_title.message: Pin Clearview to the toolbar first

wel_promise1_desc.message: All filtering happens on your computer; settings and statistics stay on this device.

wel_promise2_desc.message: We never take money from advertisers to let anyone through.

wel_promise3_desc.message: Licensed under GPL-3.0; anyone can read and improve it.

wel_support_desc.message: Clearview is free and maintained by one person in their spare time. If it makes your web calmer, buy me a coffee to keep list fixes and new features coming.

wel_tip1_desc.message: Right-click it, choose “Hide this element…” and confirm. It will not come back on that site.

wel_tip2_desc.message: Click Clearview in the toolbar to pause this site or use compatibility mode; other sites stay protected.

wel_tip3_desc.message: Add your own filter rules, manage lists, see statistics or export a backup.
